breve: Internal database of built in shader include files.
descricao: This object contains shader fragments from Godot's internal shaders. These can be used when access to internal uniform buffers and/or internal functions is required for instance when composing compositor effects or compute shaders. Only fragments for the current rendering device are loaded.

metodos.desc: Returns the code for the built-in shader fragment. You can also access this in your shader code through #include "filename".
Returns true if an include file with this name exists.
Returns a list of built-in include files that are currently registered.
